name: Marufuji Izumi
source:
A 23-year-old civil servant from Morioka. Oblivious to her large bust (presumably G to H cup size), she ends up attracting perverts, and ultimately stumbles upon the massive "Pandora Project". Her favorite celebrities are MiNiprio and Sorimatsu-kun.

[Translated from [url=http://www.shall-luck.co.jp/interlude/h2.html]the official site[/url]]
